g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to separate work and personal logins with browser
profiles: A hypothetical example and checks before
deletion
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-21
What profiles do and do not separate
According to Google Help, profiles can separate
bookmarks, browsing history, passwords, and
other settings by profile.
Switching profiles and display
settings
Click the profile icon in the upper-right corner
of Chrome to switch to another profile.
Hypothetical example: Employee A's two
profiles
The following is a hypothetical situation
created for explanation and is not an actual
company or user case.
What to check before deleting a
profile
The help page clearly states that deleting a
profile removes that profile's bookmarks,
browsing history, passwords, and other settings…
